decisions.message: Thank you for your patience in recent weeks. Instant transfers to other banks are free for the next 4 weeks. We are adding a $5 credit to your account to thank you for your patience. We have added 150 support staff for the coming weeks.
decisions.why:
Chosen by the optimizer for week 7 (everyone).
Actions: Free instant transfers to other banks, Goodwill credit to a defined group, up to 100,000 customers, Extra support staff for 4 weeks.
Cost $1,400,000 of the $4M budget.

decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. We are adding a $10 credit to your account to thank you for your patience. During the system move, card payments work offline up to $250 each (raised from $100).
decisions.why:
Chosen by the optimizer for week 6 (everyone).
Actions: Goodwill credit to a defined group, up to 100,000 customers, Offline card limit during migration $100 -> $250.
Cost $1,100,000 of the $4M budget.
